description: This file contains utility functions for ncurses-based dialog interface, including theme setup, window drawing, item management, and input handling, used within a Linux kernel configuration context.

methods.name: set_mono_theme
methods.description: Sets dialog theme attributes to monochrome (no color).

methods.name: set_classic_theme
methods.description: Configures dialog color scheme to a classic color theme.

methods.name: set_blackbg_theme
methods.description: Configures dialog color scheme with black background.

methods.name: set_bluetitle_theme
methods.description: Configures dialog color scheme with blue title accents.

methods.name: set_theme
methods.description: Selects and applies a color theme based on input string.

methods.name: init_one_color
methods.description: Initializes a color pair and sets attribute for dialog color.

methods.name: init_dialog_colors
methods.description: Initializes all dialog color pairs.

methods.name: color_setup
methods.description: Sets up color display mode based on theme and terminal capabilities.

methods.name: attr_clear
methods.description: Clears a window with a specified attribute.

methods.name: dialog_clear
methods.description: Clears the entire dialog screen, including optional background title.

methods.name: init_dialog
methods.description: Initializes curses, sets up dialog environment, and applies color theme.

methods.name: set_dialog_backtitle
methods.description: Sets the background title string for the dialog.

methods.name: set_dialog_subtitles
methods.description: Sets the list of subtitles for the dialog.

methods.name: end_dialog
methods.description: Restores cursor position, refreshes, and ends curses mode.

methods.name: print_title
methods.description: Prints centered dialog title, truncated if necessary.

methods.name: print_autowrap
methods.description: Prints text with automatic wrapping and proper handling of newlines.

methods.name: print_button
methods.description: Draws a button with label, highlighting if selected.

methods.name: draw_box
methods.description: Draws a rectangle box with line drawing characters.

methods.name: draw_shadow
methods.description: Adds a shadow effect to a window for 3D appearance.

methods.name: first_alpha
methods.description: Finds the first alphabetic character in a string, ignoring certain brackets.

methods.name: on_key_esc
methods.description: Detects ESC key sequences, filtering out escaped key sequences.

methods.name: on_key_resize
methods.description: Handles terminal resize event by clearing dialog.

methods.name: item_reset
methods.description: Resets the linked list of dialog items, freeing memory.

methods.name: item_make
methods.description: Creates a new dialog item with formatted string.

methods.name: item_add_str
methods.description: Appends formatted string to current dialog item's string.

methods.name: item_set_tag
methods.description: Sets the tag for the current dialog item.

methods.name: item_set_data
methods.description: Associates data pointer with current dialog item.

methods.name: item_set_selected
methods.description: Marks current dialog item as selected.

methods.name: item_activate_selected
methods.description: Checks if any item is selected.

methods.name: item_data
methods.description: Returns data pointer of current item.

methods.name: item_tag
methods.description: Returns tag of current item.

methods.name: item_count
methods.description: Counts total number of dialog items.

methods.name: item_set
methods.description: Sets current item by index.

methods.name: item_n
methods.description: Returns index of current item.

methods.name: item_str
methods.description: Returns string of current item.

methods.name: item_is_selected
methods.description: Checks if current item is selected.

methods.name: item_is_tag
methods.description: Checks if current item's tag matches given tag.
